title: Visiting his grandchildren in Nashville
summary: Before Detroit he stopped in Nashville, where his daughter plays bluegrass fiddle as a section musician and grandson Tom has returned to bluegrass.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Well, I guess maybe we're about done here. Just a couple of minutes more. I think I have just about everything here. Well, I think that may be --
I think I want to do one little short confession here.
Recently, before I went to Detroit, I stopped off in Nashville.

Spent some time with my two grandchildren who were -- the boy, Tom, is going to be 19 in March, and Alexandra is 17 and their mother, our daughter, is a bluegrass fiddle player who has had some success in Nashville, working as

a section musician. And my grandson now who has gone through all the phases of pop, is now gone back to what he was really -- his first environment, which was bluegrass, and he's playing acoustical guitar and singing. And I heard him a couple of weeks ago, singing in a group with his mother involved, which I got a big kick out of.
